BankAccount.__init__:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Initializes an object instance by assigning the provided balance parameter value to the instance attribute self.balance." __init__]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> balance </REF>: number "Initial balance value; defaults to 0."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Assign the value of parameter balance to instance attribute self.balance. RESULT self.balance]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
BankAccount.deposit:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Deposits a non-negative amount into the account balance and returns the updated balance." deposit]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> amount </REF>: number "The amount to add to the current balance; must be non-negative."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> return_value </REF>: number "The updated self.balance after adding amount."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Verify that amount is non-negative: the boundary 0 is allowed, and only amount < 0 triggers the validation exception. RESULT amount_valid]
            [COMMAND Add amount to the current self.balance and assign the sum back to self.balance. RESULT self.balance]
            [COMMAND Return the updated self.balance. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [EXCEPTION_FLOW: amount < 0 (strictly negative; 0 is allowed)]
        [LOG "Invalid amount"]
        [THROW ValueError "Raised when amount is negative."]
    [END_EXCEPTION_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
BankAccount.withdraw:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Withdraws a specified amount from the account balance after validating that the amount is not negative and does not exceed the current balance, returning the updated balance." withdraw]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> amount </REF>: number "The amount to withdraw from the account balance."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: number "The updated account balance after the withdrawal."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Validate that amount is non-negative; zero is allowed. RESULT amount_nonnegative_validated]
            [COMMAND Validate that amount is not greater than self.balance; equality is allowed. RESULT balance_sufficient_validated]
            [COMMAND Subtract amount from self.balance and assign the resulting value back to self.balance. RESULT updated_balance]
            [COMMAND Return the updated self.balance. RESULT withdrawal_result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [EXCEPTION_FLOW: If amount is less than 0.]
        [LOG "Invalid amount"]
        [THROW ValueError "Raised when the requested withdrawal amount is negative."]
    [END_EXCEPTION_FLOW]

    [EXCEPTION_FLOW: If amount is greater than self.balance.]
        [LOG "Insufficient balance."]
        [THROW ValueError "Raised when the requested withdrawal amount exceeds the current balance."]
    [END_EXCEPTION_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
BankAccount.view_balance:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Returns the current value of the instance attribute balance." view_balance]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> balance_value </REF>: any "The current value of the instance attribute balance."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return the current value of the instance attribute balance from self. RESULT balance_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
BankAccount.transfer:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Transfers the specified amount from the current account to the other account by withdrawing from self and depositing into other_account." transfer]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "The source account from which the amount is withdrawn."
        <REF> other_account </REF>: object "The destination account into which the amount is deposited."
        <REF> amount </REF>: number "The amount to transfer between the two accounts."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Call self.withdraw(amount) to withdraw the transfer amount from the source account. RESULT withdraw_result]
            [COMMAND Call other_account.deposit(amount) to deposit the same transfer amount into the destination account. RESULT deposit_result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
